name: Abaflex (Colendis s.r.o.)
summary: Small family-run Czech filament maker in Jihlava, founded around 2020-21 by Pavel Suchanek and trading through Colendis s.r.o. Runs its own extrusion line and has operated a direct e-shop since August 2023; the catalogue is deliberately narrow, centred on PETG+ and ASA with carbon-filled and UV-reactive variants.

product_lines.name: PETG+
product_lines.notes: House enhanced PETG grade; the '+' is the brand's own designation with no disclosed chemistry departure from base PETG.

product_lines.name: PETG+ UV
product_lines.notes: PETG carrying a UV-reactive (photochromic) pigment; base chemistry unchanged and no UV-reactive id exists.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 13-25/kg equivalent. Very small operation - a single family workshop with one extrusion line - so batch availability is limited and colour ranges are short.

provenance.conflicts: Founding year (~2020-21) and the link between the Abaflex brand and the Colendis s.r.o. legal entity come from the company's own pages; no independent registry confirmation was retrieved.
